Class SpatialTensorRasterRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.analytics.SpatialTensorRasterRenderer
public final class SpatialTensorRasterRenderer extends Object
Procedural cartographic raster rendering pipeline for 2D spatial tensors.

Translates spatial hexagonal discrete cells (\(H_3\)) into projected raster pixel canvases across multi-spectral demographic, metabolic, climatic, and sociological color palettes.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • rasterizeCellsToImage

      public static BufferedImage rasterizeCellsToImage(List<H3Cell> cells, String channel, int width, int height)
      Rasterizes a collection of H3 cells into a projected equi-rectangular BufferedImage.
      Parameters:
      cells - list of simulation cells with spatial coordinates and tensor values
      channel - target tensor channel key or description
      width - desired output image width in pixels
      height - desired output image height in pixels
      Returns:
      rendered BufferedImage, or null if cell list is empty
